connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.source: WebDAV server connection supporting RFC 4918 operations using async I/O via `HttpClientIo::HttpClientConnectionManager`. This is the preferred connection type for new code; the legacy `webdav`/`webdavs` schemes built on the synchronous `HTTPClient` remain available for backward compatibility.
connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.message: Pripojenie k serveru WebDAV podporujúce operácie podľa RFC 4918 pomocou asynchrónneho I/O cez `HttpClientIo::HttpClientConnectionManager`. Toto je odporúčaný typ pripojenia pre nový kód; zastaralé schémy `webdav`/`webdavs` postavené na synchronnom `HTTPClient` sú stále dostupné pre kompatibilitu s predchádzajúcimi verziami.

connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.source: Selects the HTTP protocol used by the async connection manager: `auto` (default; HTTP/3 preferred, falls back to HTTP/2 then HTTP/1.1), `h1`, `h2`, or `h3`.
connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.message: Vyberá použitý protokol HTTP pre manažéra asynchrónneho pripojenia: `auto` (predvolené; preferuje HTTP/3, následne HTTP/2 a potom HTTP/1.1), `h1`, `h2` alebo `h3`.

connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.source: HTTP protocol selector for the async connection manager
connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.message: Výber protokolu HTTP pre manažéra asynchrónneho spojenia

connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.source: Body sent with the advanced ping; ignored when `ping_method` is `GET` or when `ping_path`/`ping_method` are not both set
connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.message: Teleso odoslané s pokročilým pingom; ignorované, keď je `ping_method` rovné `GET` alebo keď nie sú nastavené oboje `ping_path`/`ping_method`

connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.source: Body sent with the advanced ping
Headers sent with the advanced ping; ignored when `ping_method` and `ping_path` are not both set
connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.message: Hlavičky odoslané s pokročilým pingom; ignorované, keď nie sú nastavené oboje `ping_method` a `ping_path`

connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.source: Headers sent with the advanced ping
HTTP method for an advanced ping; must be set together with `ping_path`
connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.message: HTTP metóda pre pokročilý ping; musí byť nastavená spolu s `ping_path`

connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.source: URI path for an advanced ping; must be set together with `ping_method`. Leading `/` replaces the connection path; otherwise it is appended.
connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.message: URI cesta pre pokročilé pingovanie; musí byť nastavená spolu s `ping_method`. Vodivé `/` nahradí cestu spojenia; inak sa pridá na koniec.

connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.source: Root path that will be prepended to all WebDAV operations
connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.message: Koreňová cesta, ktorá bude predponou pre všetky WebDAV operácie

connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.source: WebDAV server connection using async socket I/O
connection.V2ViRGF2Q2xpZW50SW8.scheme.V2.message: Spojenie so serverom WebDAV pomocou asynchrónneho I/O cez sockety
